host.description: Fully qualified domain name for ARSnova, like 'arsnova.example.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS.

admin_email.title: Administrator account
admin_email.description: E-mail address of a registered ARSnova user that should be granted administrator rights. Leave empty to keep everyone a regular user.

smtp_host.title: Manual SMTP relay host
smtp_host.description: Fallback plain SMTP relay (port 25, no authentication) used only when no cluster smarthost is configured. Leave empty to rely on the cluster smarthost.

smtp_from.title: Mail sender address
smtp_from.description: Sender address for ARSnova e-mails. Defaults to arsnova@<domain>.
